verdict.rationale: The firm's pages say it serves start-ups and publish founder-facing analysis, such as the 2026 Startup Notification report. No page in the evidence describes a startup package, deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms. Thought leadership and client-type mentions are adjacent material and earn no credit toward fee transparency.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes a startup package — deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms — on its own pages
